rts_policy.comparison: resolved_dp >= original_dp * threshold_fraction_original_dp; no integer rounding or epsilon
rts_policy.aggregation: never sum separate hits, including hits committed in one batch
rts_policy.radar_repeat: each independent qualifying hit increases at most one level, capped at physical Size
rts_policy.acoustic_comparison_is_interpretation: 14.2.3 says 10%; >= is the declared RTS reading
rts_policy.noisy_loud_exception: whole paragraph: neither noise nor carried coating benefit changes
rts_policy.secondary: ongoing fire/flood casualties are excluded from primary attacks
rts_policy.restoration: no automatic restoration or engineering-repair reset is inferred
rts_policy.unknown_source: persist named pending branch and reject affected automatic consumers
rts_policy.source_identity: immutable fitted profiles remain unchanged; effective damage is a typed runtime overlay
rts_policy.standalone_entry: a public standalone torpedo advance collects its actual damage until the complete source runtime is restored; the canonical simultaneous batch remains unchanged
rts_policy.mine_source_privacy: actual hidden mine hit origins remain unchanged in referee traces and physical RNG; victim receives own Impact/HP/casualty state and opaque repair cause IDs, never hidden field/model/source IDs
rts_policy.propeller: cavitation uses original fitted noise; passive detection uses the damaged noise combined with louder temporary emissions

execution_scope.radar: real Ship only, excluding EW objects, aircraft, submarines and missiles
execution_scope.acoustic: real Ship/Sub primary underwater torpedo or source mine impact only
execution_scope.other_underwater_classes: pending until actual depth-charge, ASW payload or nuclear producer supplies verified attack provenance; underwater bool alone is insufficient
execution_scope.visibility: complete threshold/hit truth Referee only; own unit view contains no attacker identity or enemy damage truth
